title: Privacy officer named, with contact
blurb: Who is accountable, and how do people reach them?

title: Purposes of collection stated
blurb: Why is each category of information collected?

title: Individual rights mentioned
blurb: Access, correction, deletion, withdrawal of consent.

title: Retention periods stated
blurb: How long is data kept, and what happens after?

title: Cross-border transfer disclosure
blurb: Does data leave Québec or Canada, and is that disclosed?

title: Consent language
blurb: Valid, informed, and specific, not just browsewrap.

title: Breach / confidentiality incident mention
blurb: Serious harm triggers CAI and individual notice.

title: Children's data addressed
blurb: Under-14 data needs express consent from a parent or guardian.

title: Automated decision-making disclosed
law: Law 25 (s. 8.5): info on exclusively automated decisions
blurb: Profiling and automated decisions must be disclosed on request.

title: Last-updated date present and recent
blurb: Stale policies erode trust and may not reflect current practice.

title: Complaint path to the regulator
blurb: People should know where to complain.
